summary: Swept model depth (6/8/10) and found DEPTH=8 (the baseline) is near depth-optimal for the 5-min budget; both shallower and deeper models were clearly worse (1.02-1.05 bpb). The real win was halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2^19 to 2^18 (more, noisier optimizer steps), which improved val_bpb from baseline 0.997359 to 0.989028 and reproduced cleanly across two independent runs. Halving further to 2^17 undid the gain (0.999683), so 2^18 is a sweet spot, not a monotonic trend. Combining the 2^18 win with a shorter LR warmdown (0.3 vs 0.5) was neutral/slightly worse (0.991526). MATRIX_LR bumped to 0.05 alone was also roughly neutral (0.998002). Next things worth trying: sweeping TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE more finely between 2^17 and 2^19 (e.g. 1.5x steps), and combining the batch-size win with Muon LR/momentum tuning rather than the warmdown schedule.
